verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a built-in natural-language chat AI Assistant for planning, prioritizing, and optimizing your schedule. The Reclaim 2.0 Schedule Assistant also suggests next actions and lets you preview calendar changes before deploying them. Underneath, the scheduler already auto-schedules and reschedules tasks on your behalf. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what actions the chat assistant can actually perform or delegate, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the chat assistant, and evidence of delegation beyond calendar scheduling.
